paradigms.title: αὐτός: he, she, it; self; same
Adjective (2-1-2, α type): holy
paradigms.note: πιστός and δίκαιος (1 John 1:9) are adjectives of the same 2nd/1st-declension kind (their feminine has η: πιστή). αἰώνιος (1:2) is different: it uses its ‑ος/‑ον forms for the feminine too, as in τὴν ζωὴν τὴν αἰώνιον.

paradigms.title: Relative pronoun: who, which, that
paradigms.note: Looks like the article with a rough breathing and an accent. 1 John 1:1 opens with the neuter ὅ four times.
